# Crypto Service Suite

> Production-grade, open-source, self-hosted post-quantum cryptography toolkit for financial institutions, fintechs, and modern enterprise architectures. Implements NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM) and FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) algorithms, a KMS interface, transparent database column encryption, and CycloneDX CBOM generation across 18 modular TypeScript packages.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

- **Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC)**: Implements NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024) for quantum-resistant key encapsulation and FIPS 204 (ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87) for post-quantum digital signatures via `@noble/post-quantum`. Provides hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM key encapsulation for seamless coexistence with classical infrastructure.
- **Sovereign Cryptography as a Service (CaaS)**: Self-hostable Fastify REST microservice exposing cryptographic operations with high-throughput streaming, rate limiting, and OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.
- **Key Management Interoperability (KMS)**: Pluggable KMS interface with envelope encryption (DEK/KEK) supporting AWS KMS and in-memory providers, with standardized abstractions for multi-cloud migration.
- **Zero-Trust Field & Column Encryption**: Seamless database field encryption adapters for Prisma and TypeORM utilizing XChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption to protect sensitive data at rest without schema rewrites.
- **Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM)**: Automated discovery, inventory, and export of cryptographic assets complying with CycloneDX 1.6 and SPDX 3.0 standards to support EU DORA compliance.
- **Edge Runtimes & Portability**: Universal runtime adapter supporting Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno, Bun, Node.js (>=22), and modern evergreen browsers.

## Priority Web & Documentation Directory

- [Homepage](https://crypto-service.co/): Primary platform overview, executive briefing, and quick-start instructions.
- [Ecosystem & Packages](https://crypto-service.co/ecosystem/): Catalog of all 18 lockstep workspace packages.
- [Solutions Architecture](https://crypto-service.co/solutions/): Detailed technical specifications for PQC, Sovereign CaaS, KMS, Field Encryption, and Edge Runtimes.
- [Cryptographic Standards](https://crypto-service.co/standards/): FIPS 203, FIPS 204, FIPS 205, CNSA 2.0 alignment, and DORA compliance mapping.
- [Whitepapers & Sovereign CaaS](https://crypto-service.co/whitepapers/sovereign-caas/): In-depth architectural analysis on post-quantum infrastructure sovereignty and risk mitigation against Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later (HNDL) attacks.
- [Research & Threat Modeling](https://crypto-service.co/research/): Cryptographic threat models, algorithm comparison matrix, and hardware benchmark guides.
- [About & Governance](https://crypto-service.co/about/): Project mission, maintainer credentials, open-source governance, and security disclosures.
- [Official Documentation Portal](https://docs.crypto-service.co/): Full TypeDoc API reference across all 18 modules.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/sebastienrousseau/crypto-service): Source code, Vitest test suites (100% coverage floor), and CI/CD pipelines.
